title: From Page to Knight
brief: Hoo! Let’s visit a castle. Becoming a knight took years of training. Build a knight ready for the castle, then take a photo for your teacher.
look: This stop is a castle in the Middle Ages. A boy began as a page, became a squire, and then was dubbed a knight.

models.name: Optima Domi Knight
models.why: he was dubbed in a ceremony

steps.title: Know your models
steps.text: These are your four models. Say each name out loud. This list is also in VR, in the **Canvas** tab.

steps.title: Build it
steps.text: Press the **top button on your right controller** and click **Models**. Put the **knight** by the castle gate. Put the **shield** and **sword** by him. Put the **horse** next to him.

steps.title: Say it out loud
steps.frame: “A squire took care of ___. A knight had to be ___.”
steps.text: Point to the knight and say this out loud:
steps.spoken: Point to the knight and say this out loud. A squire took care of… A knight had to be…

steps.title: Snap and submit
steps.fits: the knight, the shield, the sword and the horse

extra.text: Hold the **sword** over the knight’s shoulder, like he is being **dubbed**. Say the three things chivalry asked of him.

points: Your photo shows the knight, the shield, the sword and the horse at the castle.

mapday.intro: No headset today? It’s Road Map Day. Read each clue and tap page, squire or knight. Then finish two sentences about knights.
mapday.miss: Not that one. Remember the order: page, squire, knight.
mapday.done: ✓ Page, squire, knight! Now finish the two sentences.

scene.aria: A castle with three spots in order: first, second and third

clues.q: First, he serves in a noble household and learns basic skills.
Around age fourteen, he becomes a knight’s helper.
He cares for the knight’s armor and horse.
He is dubbed in a formal ceremony.
He must follow chivalry: be brave, loyal and courteous.
